speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a child with a 3-week history of fatigue, fever, easy bruising, and severe leg pain. To understand the cause of your severe leg pain and bruising, are the bones of your legs very tender to the touch?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old girl. The patient has been experiencing generalized fatigue and easy bruising for 3 weeks. Over the past week, she has developed a fever and severe leg pain that wakes her up at night.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Osteosarcoma (suspicion of bone malignancy). 

Given the 3-week history of fatigue, fever, easy bruising, and severe night pain in a 4-year-old, this presentation is highly concerning for a primary bone tumor like osteosarcoma or a high-grade leukemia such as ALL. I am proceeding with a full workup including a CBC, peripheral smear, ESR/CRP, and a plain radiograph of the most painful leg.
